# Synthetic archive fixtures

Own stored RAR4/RAR5 fixtures are authored by scripts/fixtures-rar.py from synthetic image fixtures; bsdtar independently verifies each payload. pages.7z was generated by system bsdtar 7zip output from the authored pages.tar.

The following small compressed/encrypted/volume regression inputs come from the verified libarchive 3.8.10 source tree, libarchive/test, under its bundled test/source licenses. They are archive-regression data, not personal comics or documents.

`rar4-compressed-single.cbr` retains only the independent first compressed file header/payload from test_read_format_rar_compress_normal.rar.uu, plus its main header and a recomputed end header. Its expected HTML payload is independently extracted with bsdtar and hashed by tests. Unicode TAR/7z fixtures are authored from the local synthetic PNG.

Encrypted 7z/header-encrypted fixtures are decoded from the corresponding test_read_format_7zip_encryption*.7z.uu files in the same pinned libarchive source tree. Duplicate/traversal/many-entry TARs are authored synthetic headers with no filesystem extraction.
